January, February, March

The paragraph presents several legal issues regarding the enforceability of the non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and the validity of the termination. First, the absence of a witness to the signing raises questions about the formal execution of the contract, although in many jurisdictions, a witness is not strictly required for an NDA to be valid unless specific statutory formalities apply. Second, Alex’s claim of unawareness of the restrictions touches on the legal concepts of mutual assent and informed consent; if Alex did not have reasonable notice of the terms, the agreement may be deemed unenforceable due to lack of meeting of the minds. Finally, the core legal issue is whether the employer can legally terminate employment based on a breach of an agreement that may be void or voidable due to these procedural and informational defects.
